summary.text: On Zendikar, Nahiri returns determined to rid the plane of the Roil, and she hires adventurers including Akiri and Zareth San to help her retrieve the last lithoform core from the Murasa Skyclave.

She seizes the Core, which kills Zareth and leaves Akiri pushed off a ledge, while Nissa Revane, who will not stand by as the plane tears itself apart, and Jace Beleren, who is keeping the secret that Bolas lives, set out to stop her.

The conflict comes to a head at the Singing City, where Jace takes control of Nahiri's mind and Ashaya delivers the Core to Nissa, who merges her magic with it, flattens the city and heals Zendikar, while Nahiri swears revenge and planeswalks away.
